_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: In the wilderness, what wounded was lifted up to heal.
We look to the cross and live.
God so loved the world that he gave his only Son.
We look to the cross and live.
The message of the cross is the power of God.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Remember the desert: a people dying of their own venom, told to look up at the thing that wounded them.
We look to the cross and live.
What the world calls foolishness — a man on a tree — God calls power and wisdom.
We look to the cross and live.
For God so loved the world that he gave, and gave, and held nothing back.
We look to the cross and live.
So lift your eyes to the lifted Christ; not to condemn the world, but to save it.
We look to the cross and live!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: What wounded us is lifted up to heal.
We look to the cross and live.
The foolishness of the cross is the power of God.
We look to the cross and live.
God so loved the world that he gave his Son.
We look to the cross and live. Amen.
